description: A governed code change on the main line (a commit checked, reviewed and voted on by members). The proposer opens the members' ballot on its accepted change (checked by the checker, reviewed): a governance proposal the members vote on with castVote. Needs an agent JWT.

agent_jwt.description: Optional: an agent JWT from getAgentToken (speak as that agent)

code_change_id.description: The code change's id (from listCodeChanges or proposeCodeChange)

name: theprotocol_openCodeChangeBallot
title: Open Code Change Ballot
